title: Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning for Asset-Liability Management
abstract: arXiv:2509.23280v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach for Asset-Liability Management (ALM) by employing continuous-time Reinforcement Learning (RL) with a linear-quadratic (LQ) formulation that incorporates both interim and terminal objectives. We develop a model-free, policy gradient-based soft actor-critic algorithm tailored to ALM for dynamically synchronizing assets and liabilities. To ensure an effective balance between exploration and exploitation with minimal tuning, we introduce adaptive exploration for the actor and scheduled exploration for the critic. Our empirical study evaluates this approach against two enhanced traditional financial strategies, a model-based continuous-time RL method, and three state-of-the-art RL algorithms. Evaluated across 200 randomized market scenarios, our method achieves higher average rewards than all alternative strategies, with rapid initial gains and sustained superior performance. translated_title: 资产负债管理的连续时间强化学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种资产负债管理（ALM）的新方法，采用连续时间强化学习（RL）并结合同时纳入中期和终期目标的线性二次（LQ）公式。我们开发了一种无模型、基于策略梯度的软演员-评论家算法，专为资产负债管理量身定制，用于动态同步资产与负债。为了在最小调参的情况下确保探索与利用之间的有效平衡，我们为演员引入了自适应探索机制，为评论家引入了计划性探索机制。我们的实证研究将该方法与两种增强的传统金融策略、一种基于模型的连续时间强化学习方法以及三种最先进的强化学习算法进行了对比。在200个随机化市场场景中的评估表明，我们的方法比所有替代策略获得了更高的平均回报，具有快速的初期收益和持续的优越表现。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合线性二次公式的连续时间无模型软演员-评论家强化学习方法，通过演员的自适应探索和评论家的计划性探索机制动态同步资产与负债，在200个随机市场场景中取得了优于传统金融策略和其他最先进强化学习算法的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a continuous-time, model-free soft actor-critic reinforcement learning method with a linear-quadratic formulation, using adaptive exploration for the actor and scheduled exploration for the critic to dynamically synchronize assets and liabilities, achieving superior performance over traditional financial strategies and state-of-the-art RL algorithms across 200 randomized market scenarios.
